definitions.explanation: The direction opposite to south, toward the Arctic in the Northern Hemisphere.

examples.japanese: ⟦{北海道|ほっかいどう}→北海道：11010_hokkaidou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{北|きた}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦あります→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Hokkaido is in the north of Japan.

examples.japanese: ⟦{駅|えき}→駅：02180_eki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{北口|きたぐち}→北口：11056_kitaguchi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{待|ま}っています→待つ：00469_matsu⟧。
examples.english: I'll be waiting at the north exit of the station.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{北|きた}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{歩|ある}く→歩く：00538_aruku⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{大|おお}きい→大きい：00335_ookii⟧⟦{公園|こうえん}→公園：00581_kouen⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あります→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: If you walk north on this road, there's a big park.

notes:
{北|きた} is one of the four cardinal directions in Japanese.

THE FOUR DIRECTIONS:
- ⟦{東|ひがし}→東：02250_higashi⟧: east
- ⟦{西|にし}→西：00659_nishi⟧: west
- ⟦{南|みなみ}→南：00652_minami⟧: south
- {北|きた}: north

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{北口|きたぐち}→北口：11056_kitaguchi⟧: north exit (at stations)
- ⟦{北側|きたがわ}→北側：27541_kitagawa⟧: north side
- ⟦{北風|きたかぜ}→北風：21247_kitakaze⟧: north wind
- ⟦{北海道|ほっかいどう}→北海道：11010_hokkaidou⟧: Hokkaido ("northern sea road")
- ⟦{北極|ほっきょく}→北極：16689_hokkyoku⟧: North Pole
- ⟦{東北|とうほく}→東北：27542_touhoku⟧: Tohoku (northeast Japan)

USAGE WITH PARTICLES:
- {北|きた}⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧: to go north (direction)
- {北|きた}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{住|す}む→住む：00673_sumu⟧: to live in the north (location)
- {北|きた}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{来|く}る→来る：00254_kuru⟧: to come from the north (origin)

CULTURAL NOTE:
Station exits in Japan are often labeled by cardinal direction (⟦{北口|きたぐち}→北口：11056_kitaguchi⟧, ⟦{南口|みなみぐち}→南口：24066_minamiguchi⟧, etc.). This is essential for navigating and giving directions.
